name: botdoor
description: Owner-controlled access to a Windows PC through the BotDoor companion.

interface.longDescription: Use BotDoor to check your Windows companion's connection and owner permission, inspect an approved window, and perform permitted actions during an owner-authorized time window. Requires a separately installed Windows host, a provisioned private relay, and a bot-only credential configured privately on the runner. The host must remain awake, unlocked, and running. One-window mode permits guarded input in the selected app; PC access mode permits viewing, focus, scroll, pointer movement, window movement and closing, and exact-path executable launch, while blocking clicks, typing, drag, editing keys and clipboard writes. Closing can discard unsaved work; launching an existing program can have side effects. Local STOP and Ctrl+Shift+F12 revoke access. It cannot unlock Windows, control UAC, guarantee frozen-app recovery, or provide continuous live video. This package uses a local stdio MCP adapter; public directory review requires a hosted HTTPS MCP endpoint or an approved local-MCP exception. Independent software; no OpenAI or xAI endorsement.
defaultPrompt: Check whether my BotDoor PC is connected and whether access is enabled.
Show the owner-approved window while access is enabled.

publication.release_notes: Initial local Codex package for the BotDoor 1.6 contract. Public submission remains gated on transport, public policy URLs and reviewer acceptance.
